subject: Mutual plan launch: roles, milestones, and Q4 evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@stratoshealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan launch: roles, milestones, and Q4 evaluation timeline

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. I wanted to kick off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on stakeholders, success criteria, and a realistic timeline for the evaluation you mentioned. Goal is to make the technical and procurement steps visible so we can get you into a pilot in a safe, measurable way.

Quick intro for context: I’m Camila (your AE) and I’m looping Aditya (Solutions Engineer) and Marissa (Customer Success) so we can align roles from day one.

Proposed goals (please amend):
- Objective: Run a targeted 2-week pilot of the Redwood inference runtime for the Stratos triage/EMR summarization workflow.
- Success criteria: end-to-end latency under 450ms for 95th percentile, >= 90% extractive accuracy on the evaluation prompt set, and cost-per-API-token within the agreed range.
- Decision milestone: internal evaluation review + procurement sign-off by end of Q4 (target decision week of 2026-11-30).

Suggested initial milestone timeline (can compress if you prefer):
1) Kickoff & tech scoping (30 min): week of 2026-09-21
2) Environment provisioning & test data exchange: complete by 2026-10-05
3) 2-week pilot window: 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-25
4) Results review & executive summary: 2026-11-02

I’ve attached a short MAP template (Redwood_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Template.xlsx) that we can fill collaboratively. Could you confirm: 1) you’re the evaluation champion; 2) any other internal stakeholders to include; and 3) your availability for a 30-min kickoff next week?

Attachments: Redwood_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_Template.xlsx (MAP template)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@stratoshealth.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 10:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan launch: roles, milestones, and Q4 evaluation timeline

Camila —

Appreciate the clear plan. Yes, I’ll be the evaluation champion for Stratos. Quick notes and additional stakeholders:
- Dr. Elisa Park (VP Product) will own product sign-off and should join the kickoff.
- Procurement will need to be in the loop for SOW/terms — procurement@stratoshealth.com (I’ll intro in a separate thread if helpful).
- We have a compliance reviewer (internal) who may want to validate logging controls; I’ll surface their name after the kickoff.

The timeline looks reasonable. I can do Tue 2026-09-22 at 10:00 AM PT or Wed 2026-09-23 at 2:00 PM PT for a 30-min kickoff — Tue 9/22 preferred.

On the success criteria you listed: the latency target and evaluation window make sense. For accuracy, we’ll also include a clinical review pass/fail for any flagged summaries as an additional gating metric.

Thanks — attaching nothing here but I’ll confirm the procurement contact shortly.

Jordan — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming. Tue 2026-09-22 at 10:00 AM PT is locked on my calendar — invite sent with a short agenda (tech scoping, data handling checklist, confirmation of success criteria, and next steps).

Next steps on our side before the meeting:
- Aditya will prepare a short tech checklist and environment needs doc (he’ll bring that to the kickoff).
- I’ll upload the MAP template to a shared Drive and create the initial draft with the proposed milestones (link below).
- I’ve attached a first-pass SOW (RDW_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) for procurement to review; it’s intentionally high level and we can iterate.

Shared links:
- MAP draft: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1AbcDredwoodMAP
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/4321

If procurement prefers a DocuSign flow, we can prepare that after the kickoff once terms are clearer.

Attachments: RDW_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

See you Tuesday — agenda + calendar invite in separate email.

Best,
